result.analyst_notes: Corporate, principle-list framing led by shareholder value, then customers and communities. Mix of hedged commitments (we strive, we work to) and absolute ones (we uphold the highest standards, highest regard). First-person plural throughout. Safety, environment, integrity, citizenship and inclusion appear as named principles. Innovation is absent.
